# Game trailer from code: record a browser game frame by frame and cut it

**Record the three.js game your agent built with exact frames, scripted shots and trailer cameras, then cut it on the beat to a 1080p trailer.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/4325c578-378d-4c43-ae53-3cc3218df1ea/file_0a9bdd0e2104.webp" alt="Trailer of a browser game made in code: a paper-lantern glider with red wings flies through a dusk canyon, trailing sparks, past a score counter." width="480"></p>

Turn a browser game or three.js / WebGL scene an agent built into a cinematic trailer MP4: a virtual clock injected before the page's scripts makes every frame exact at 30 or 60 fps, a director JSON scripts each shot (key and mouse inputs, game setup, trailer camera paths, slow motion, HTML titles and end cards), headless Chrome captures 1920x1080 frames, ffmpeg cuts them on the beat, a music bed (code-written or from varg) is normalised to -14 LUFS, and a checker measures frozen frames, loudness, debug text, third-party names and claims. Includes a tested example game. Use when someone asks for a game trailer, to record my three.js game, a gameplay video, a trailer for my browser game, a Fable 5.2 game video or a fake AAA gameplay trailer. Not for HTML motion graphics (hyperframes), 3D previz for AI video (threejs-animatic), AI-generated footage (varg-ai) or editing existing footage (short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill code-game-trailer                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills code-game-trailer --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 20-second trailer of the three.js game in this folder, with a title card and music"
- "Record my browser game as a cinematic gameplay video I can post on X"
- "Fable 5.2 built me a game in one HTML file; cut a trailer for it with slow motion on the best moment"
